clusters.name: hook-timeout-cascade-fix
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial single cluster. Every story ends in the same single crews version bump plus one CHANGELOG.md and one AGENTS.md version entry, and the three hot-path stories (US-002/003/004) all edit hooks/actors.js and hooks/safe-io.js. Splitting across parallel members would produce conflicting version-file writes and overlapping edits to the same modules. Per codexu AGENTS.md 'same-plugin parallel = conflict; must serialize', this runs as ONE impl member with the internal order US-001 -> US-002 -> US-003 -> US-004 -> US-005 -> US-006.
